card.title: Raise the Impossibility
card.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For my restaurant, your flying chair needs a flying table. Dinner should travel with the diner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can make the whole table circle the room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Add a hovering waiter. Nobody should chase their soup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter can serve while flying upside down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then commission gravity-proof soup. I won't make customers rotate between courses.

mechanism: A demands increasingly impossible dining arrangements justified by the practical consequences of B's flying-service offers.
confusable: Unlike arbitrary magical escalation, A must explain each greater commitment through guest convenience.
comparison: Airborne restaurant service contrasts with the wedding alternative's multiplying hospitality for separated guests.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
